comment: Independent C-first recording for options.c:handler_menustyle(), reached through optfn_menustyle()'s do_handler arm from the full options menu. The handler menu shows each menutype[] row with its two description lines; 't' picks traditional and prints the 'changed to' message, a step west plays on, and a second visit takes 'p' (partial) to show the value column and message for another row.
